title: Implement Trie (Prefix Tree)
description:
Build a prefix tree (trie) class `PrefixTree` for lowercase strings.

- `insert(word)` stores `word`.
- `search(word)` returns `true` only if exactly `word` was inserted earlier.
- `startsWith(prefix)` returns `true` if some inserted word begins with `prefix`.

examples.input: insert("dog"), search("dog"), search("do"), startsWith("do"), insert("do"), search("do")
examples.output: null, true, false, true, null, true
examples.explanation: "do" is only a prefix of "dog" until it is inserted itself.

hints: Storing all words in a list makes startsWith scan every word. Can words that share a beginning share storage?
Give each node a map from a letter to a child node, plus a flag saying whether a word ends here.
Walk one node per character. search needs the final node's end flag; startsWith only needs the walk to succeed.

args.$py: [[]]+[["a"*i+"b"] for i in range(1,2001)]+[["a"*i+"b"] for i in range(1,2001)]+[["a"*i] for i in range(1,2001)]

solution.explanation: Each trie node holds a dict of children keyed by letter and a boolean marking the end of an inserted word. insert follows (creating as needed) one node per letter and flags the last. search and startsWith share a helper that walks the letters and returns the final node or None; search additionally requires the end flag. Every operation costs O(L) for a string of length L, and space is proportional to the characters stored.
